docs.title: 📖 About This Course
docs.text: This course provides a comprehensive theoretical foundation for data science, covering statistical learning theory, computational learning theory, optimization, and online learning algorithms.

docs.title: Learning Approach

docs.title: 🎯 Course Overview
docs.text: This course covers fundamental theories that underpin modern data science and machine learning.

docs.title: Course Structure
docs.text:
Details about the course structure, including the specific topics and their organization, will be provided at the start of the semester.

Tentative Topics: - Mathematical Preliminaries - Statistical Learning Theory - PAC Learning Framework - VC Dimension and Complexity - Regularization and Model Selection - Ensemble Methods - Online Learning and Optimization

docs.title: 📖 Learning Format
docs.text: The learning format and session structure will be announced at the beginning of the course.

docs.title: 🎓 Learning Objectives
docs.text:
By the end of this course, you will be able to:

  1. Understand theoretical foundations of statistical and computational learning
  2. Analyze generalization guarantees and sample complexity of learning algorithms
  3. Apply PAC learning framework, VC dimension, and related theoretical tools
  4. Design and analyze regularization and model selection techniques
  5. Prove convergence guarantees for learning algorithms
  6. Bridge theory and practice in modern machine learning applications

docs.title: 💡 Prerequisites
docs.text:
This course assumes:

  • ✅ Strong foundation in linear algebra, calculus, and probability
  • ✅ Familiarity with basic algorithms and data structures
  • ✅ Comfort with mathematical proofs and formal reasoning
  • ✅ Programming experience for implementing theoretical concepts
